distinction_from_research_samples: A/B/C are economic measure families, not the project Sample A/B/C data cohorts.

families.name: verification_concentration
families.question: Who verifies?
families.economic_scope: Concentration, breadth and threshold dependence of observed verification activity.

families.name: incentives_and_frictions
families.question: Why verify?
families.economic_scope: Configured incentives, capital at risk, liquidity and delay frictions, verification costs and scenario-based expected private utility.

families.name: accountability_outcomes
families.question: What happens after verification?
families.economic_scope: Challenge, adjudication, transfer, payoff, delay and censoring outcomes, with protocol resolution kept separate from independent factual truth.
